metadata.question: Was the water extent around the location (11.184384, 35.114837) greater on February 14, 2022 than on February 6, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point(11.184384, 35.114837) in Sudan/Ethiopia region - Two dates to compare: February 14, 2022 vs February 6, 2019 - Need water extent data - will use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR (better for specific dates) - Sentinel-1 is better for specific date comparisons as it's not affected by clouds - Will create a buffer around the point to analyze water extent in the area 2. Masking strategy: - For Sentinel-1 SAR data, no cloud masking needed - Will use VV polarization and threshold to detect water (typically VV < -15 dB indicates water) - Calculate water area for both dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water area = 0 is valid (means no water detected) - C1: No Sentinel-1 images found for either date - C2: Images exist but after processing, no valid pixels (unlikely with SAR) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: 2022 water extent > 2019 water extent - B: 2022 water extent <= 2019 water extent ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([11.184384, 35.114837]); const region = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around point const date1 = '2019-02-06'; const date2 = '2022-02-14'; // 2. Data Acquisition for both dates const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019-02-06 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`2022-02-14 images: ${size2}`); // Check for empty collections - try wider date range if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Trying wider date range...'); const col1_wide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-02-15') .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')); const col2_wide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate('2022-02-01', '2022-02-28') .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')); const size1_wide = col1_wide.size().getInfo(); const size2_wide = col2_wide.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Wider range - 2019: ${size1_wide}, 2022: ${size2_wide}`); if (size1_wide === 0 || size2_wide === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } var img1 = col1_wide.first(); var img2 = col2_wide.first(); } else { var img1 = col1.first(); var img2 = col2.first(); } // 3. Processing - Water detection using VV polarization const vv1 = img1.select('VV'); const vv2 = img2.select('VV'); // Water mask: VV < -15 dB typically indicates water const water1 = vv1.lt(-15); const water2 = vv2.lt(-15); // 4. Calculate water area const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const waterArea1_dict = water1.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterArea2_dict = water2.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterArea1 = waterArea1_dict.get('VV').getInfo(); const waterArea2 = waterArea2_dict.get('VV').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 water area: ${(waterArea1 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2022 water area: ${(waterArea2 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (waterArea1 === null || waterArea2 === null || isNaN(waterArea1) || isNaN(waterArea2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (waterArea2 > waterArea1) { console.log('Water extent was greater in 2022'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water extent was NOT greater in 2022'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
